features: ADVANCED SYSTEM PROJECTOR & RICH CONTENT: WELLSONIC smart projector is equipped with the latest Android TV 11.0 system, featuring a wide range of built-in applications. It provides easy access to mainstream streaming platforms such as Prime Video, and YouTube, offering a vast content library of over 500,000 movies and TV shows. Combined with the Mali-G31 GPU and WiFi 6 technology, it delivers a smooth and intelligent viewing experience

MULTI-SCENARIO FLEXIBLE PROJECTION: WELLSONIC smart movie projector supports 180° free rotation, allowing for easy projection on walls, ceilings, or floors without complicated setup. It is suitable for various scenarios, including home theaters, leisure entertainment, children's education, video conferences or online teaching, meeting diverse usage needs

INTELLIGENT CORRECTION & IMMERSIVE SOUND: WELLSONIC HY300 smart projector features built-in automatic keystone correction that quickly adjusts the image to its optimal state, while manual focus ensures a clear picture in an instant. The 360-degree surround sound system provides an immersive auditory experience, turning every viewing session into an audiovisual experience

HIGH-DEFINITION PICTURE QUALITY & SMOOTH CONNECTIVITY: WELLSONIC smart projector supports 1080P/4K resolution, utilizing advanced LED technology to deliver bright and realistic projection effects. Seamless connectivity is achieved through WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0, compatible with both 2.4G and 5G networks, ensuring smooth streaming

QUIET OPERATION & MULTI-FUNCTIONAL EXPANSION: WELLSONIC efficient cooling system keeps operational noise below 25 decibels, providing a quiet viewing environment. Equipped with HDMI, USB, and audio interfaces, it can easily connect to external devices such as laptops, TV sticks, and USB drives, enabling seamless compatibility and expanding entertainment possibilities

PORTABLE DESIGN & SHORT-THROW PROJECTION: Compact and lightweight design allows for easy portability and setup in any room. The upgraded short-focus lens enables projection of a 100-inch screen from just 2 meters away, maximizing space utilization and providing flexible installation options for various room sizes
